decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 31st May 2006, an erection of a rear dormer and a hip to gable roof extension and the installation of four roof lights to the front roof plane with the volume of 49.23m3 which would give a total volume increase to the original house of 65.54m3, as shown on drawing numbers 6035-01 (amended), received 07th July 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a rear dormer and a hip to gable roof extension and the installation of four roof lights to the front roof plane, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension incorporating rooflight to house
